sources.title: SMILE-Next - mok0102.github.io
sources.snippet: SMILE-Next defines three laughter-related tasks: Laughter Detection, Laughter Classification, and Laughter Reasoning. Abstract Laughter is a complex social signal that conveys communicative intent beyond amusement.

sources.title: M0kI's bloG - JungMok Lee
sources.snippet: We introduce the SMILE-NEXT, a comprehensive corpus combining audio, visual, and textual cues for laughter understanding across diverse contexts. We propose Laugh Expert MOE architecture, a lightweight yet expressive model architecture to efficiently model laughter perception.
